title: Sideman sessions with Sharkey on Bandwagon
summary: Sessions with Sharkey around 1949 on Roger Wolfe's Bandwagon label.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Speaking of records, what about records with bands where you function as a sideman, with any sessions that you think, either from your point of view or as a whole were more outstanding than others that you can think of offhand?
Well, I think some of the sessions that I made with Sharky were very good from a real Dixieland standpoint.
Well, that was the beginning of the revival of Dixieland around 1949. It was on a label called Bandwagon. That's Roger Wolfe. It was Roger Wolfe, the old disc jockey from WDSU. It was his label.
